1 Filter data

1.1 Load data

xenium -> SeuratObject::UpdateSeuratObject(readRDS("./xenium_all_TMAs_combined.Rds"))


1.2 Filter

meta <- xenium[[]]

is_minor_cancer <- grepl("Cancer", meta$Minor_cell_annotation)
is_major_cancer <- meta$Major_cell_annotation %in% "Cancer Epithelial"

# check how the two levels agree before choosing AND or OR
table(minor = is_minor_cancer, major = is_major_cancer)

keep <- is_minor_cancer & is_major_cancer        # both levels agree (stricter)
# keep <- is_minor_cancer | is_major_cancer      # either level (more permissive)

xenium <- SeuratObject::UpdateSeuratObject(xenium)
xenium_cancer <- subset(xenium, cells = rownames(meta)[keep])
## An object of class Seurat 
## 5001 features across 171766 samples within 1 assay 
## Active assay: Xenium (5001 features, 5001 variable features)
##  3 layers present: counts, data, scale.data
##  2 dimensional reductions calculated: pca, umap
##  4 spatial fields of view present: TMA13 TMA15 TMA17 all_TMA_display


1.3 Dimensional reduction

xenium_cancer <- ScaleData(xenium_cancer)
xenium_cancer <- RunPCA(xenium_cancer, npcs = 50)
ElbowPlot(xenium_cancer, ndims = 50)          # pick the number of PCs from this

xenium_cancer <- FindNeighbors(xenium_cancer, dims = 1:50, k.param = 16)
xenium_cancer <- FindClusters(xenium_cancer, resolution = 0.5)
xenium_cancer <- RunUMAP(xenium_cancer, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:50)

xenium_cancer

2 UMAPs

2.1 By cell type

n_cells = nrow(xenium_cancer@meta.data)

umap_cancer_tissue_MNr =
  Seurat::DimPlot(xenium_cancer,
                  group.by = "M.nr",
                  raster=T,
                  raster.dpi = c(800,800)) + # geom_scattermore() for rasterization
  xlab("UMAP1") +
  ylab("UMAP2") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_mnr,
                     breaks = names(colors_mnr)) +
  ggtitle(label = "**Cancer cells | Patient**",
          subtitle = paste0("*n* = ", prettyNum(n_cells, big.mark = ","))) +
  umap_theme
  


umap_cancer_tissue_types =
  Seurat::DimPlot(xenium_cancer,
                  group.by = "Tissue_type",
                  raster=T,
                  raster.dpi = c(800,800)) + # geom_scattermore() for rasterization
  xlab("UMAP1") +
  ylab("UMAP2") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_tissue_type,
                     breaks = names(colors_tissue_type)) +
  ggtitle(label = "**Cancer cells | Tissue origin**",
          subtitle = paste0("*n* = ", prettyNum(n_cells, big.mark = ","))) +
  umap_theme


umap_cancer_cell_types_minor =
  Seurat::DimPlot(xenium_cancer,
                  group.by = "Minor_cell_annotation",
                  raster=T,
                  raster.dpi = c(800,800)) + # geom_scattermore() for rasterization
  xlab("UMAP1") +
  ylab("UMAP2") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_cancer_cells_minor,
                     breaks = names(colors_cancer_cells_minor)) +
  ggtitle(label = "**Cancer cells | cell type (minor)**",
          subtitle = paste0("*n* = ", prettyNum(n_cells, big.mark = ","))) +
  umap_theme



umap_cancer_n.genes =
  Seurat::FeaturePlot(xenium_cancer,
                      features = "nFeature_Xenium",
                      reduction = "umap",
                      raster = TRUE,
                      raster.dpi = c(800, 800), # geom_scattermore() for rasterization
                      max.cutoff = "q90") +
  viridis::scale_color_viridis(limits = c(0,quantile(xenium_cancer@meta.data$nFeature_Xenium,0.9)),
                               guide = "colorbar",
                               na.value = viridis::viridis(10)[10]) +
  xlab("UMAP1") +
  ylab("UMAP2") +
  ggtitle(label = "**Cancer cells | N genes per cell**",
          subtitle = paste0("*n* = ", prettyNum(n_cells, big.mark = ","))) +
  umap_theme

patchwork::wrap_plots(umap_cancer_cell_types_minor, umap_cancer_tissue_MNr,
                      umap_cancer_tissue_types, umap_cancer_n.genes)


2.2 Gene expression

min.cutoff = 0
max.cutoff = "q90"

genes_to_plot = c("ER\u03B1" = "ESR1",
                  "PR" = "PGR",
                  "HER2" = "ERBB2")
umap_gene.exp_cancer = list()

for (i in 1:length(genes_to_plot)) {
  umap_gene.exp_cancer[[i]] =
    Seurat::FeaturePlot(xenium_cancer,
                        features = genes_to_plot[i],
                        min.cutoff = min.cutoff,
                        max.cutoff = max.cutoff,
                        cols = expression_palette,
                        keep.scale = "feature",
                        raster=TRUE,
                        raster.dpi = c(800,800)) + # geom_scattermore() for rasterization
    xlab("UMAP1") +
    ylab("UMAP2") +
    ggtitle(label = paste0("**Cancer cells | ",names(genes_to_plot)[i],"**"),
            subtitle = paste0("*n* = ", prettyNum(n_cells, big.mark = ","))) +
    umap_theme
}

patchwork::wrap_plots(umap_gene.exp_cancer, nrow = 1)


2.3 Gene signatures

2.3.1 Computing scores

expr <- LayerData(xenium_cancer, assay = "Xenium", layer = "data")

# list of gene sets
hallamrks = msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H")

signatures_li =
  msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "C2", subcollection = "CGP") %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl("^LI_ESTROGENE", gs_name))

geneSets <-
  list(HALLMARK_ESTROGEN_RESPONSE_LATE = hallamrks$gene_symbol[hallamrks$gs_name %in% "HALLMARK_ESTROGEN_RESPONSE_LATE"],
       HALLMARK_ESTROGEN_RESPONSE_EARLY = hallamrks$gene_symbol[hallamrks$gs_name %in% "HALLMARK_ESTROGEN_RESPONSE_EARLY"])


# Build per-cell gene rankings
rankings = AUCell_buildRankings(expr, nCores = 20, plotStats = FALSE)

# Compute AUC (gene-set activity)
auc = AUCell_calcAUC(geneSets, rankings, aucMaxRank = ceiling(0.05 * nrow(rankings)))
aucMat = getAUC(auc) # matrix: geneSets x cells


# Add to xenium_cancer seurat object the results
xenium_cancer[["AUCell"]] = CreateAssayObject(data = aucMat)


2.3.2 Plotting signature UMAPs

min.cutoff = 0
max.cutoff = "q90"

signature_UMAPs = list()

for (i in 1:length(geneSets)) {
  signature_id = names(geneSets)[i]
  
  signature_UMAPs[[i]] =
    Seurat::FeaturePlot(xenium_cancer,
                        features = gsub("_","-",names(geneSets)[[i]]),
                        min.cutoff = min.cutoff,
                        max.cutoff = max.cutoff,
                        cols = expression_palette,
                        keep.scale = "feature",
                        assay = "AUCell",
                        raster=T,
                        raster.dpi = c(800,800)) + # geom_scattermore() for rasterization
    xlab("UMAP1") +
    ylab("UMAP2") +
    ggtitle(label = paste0("**AUCell | ", gsub("_"," ",tolower(names(geneSets)[[i]])),"**"),
            subtitle = paste0("*n* = ", prettyNum(n_cells, big.mark = ","))) +
    umap_theme
}

patchwork::wrap_plots(signature_UMAPs, nrow = 1)
